stories.title: Roadworks round-up: what is closed and where across Deeside and Flintshire this week
stories.summary: Shotton Lane in Shotton is closed from today until Wednesday for water utility works, one of eleven road closures in place across Flintshire this week. stories.title: Countess of Chester Country Park keeps Green Flag Award for ninth year
stories.summary: The country park next to the Countess of Chester Hospital has kept its Green Flag Award for a ninth consecutive year. stories.title: Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell to host bus network consultation events
stories.summary: Four public drop-in events on the future of bus services in Flintshire will be held in Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell in September.
